scope: Phase 10 macOS low-level fallback discovery after Swift 6-safe ScreenCaptureKit correction

prerequisiteEvidence.phase10DiscoveryS01Block: CGDisplayCreateImage unavailable on macOS 26.5; ScreenCaptureKit required
prerequisiteEvidence.phase10DiscoveryS02Block: Swift JSON serialization expression mixed String? and NSNull before helper execution

purpose: Execute the first real non-mutating Phase 10 primitive discovery after resolving both historical helper compilation blocks.

resultPolicy.BLOCKED: The corrected discovery helper still cannot compile/run, the current Quartz event is unavailable, or the macOS environment cannot be inspected. No permission request or synthetic input is delivered.
resultPolicy.FAIL: Executed discovery data contradict coordinate, display, event-construction or non-prompting capture invariants.
resultPolicy.PASS: Real coordinate systems and primitive availability are observed coherently without synthetic input delivery or permission prompts; ScreenCaptureKit capture is attempted only when already authorized.

nextStepOnPass: Read the concrete evidence before defining Phase 10 public APIs. Split capture from input mutation and validate each independently; semantic APIs remain higher priority than fallbacks.
nextStepOnBlockedOrFail: Preserve this evidence and diagnose forward. Do not alter the product or infer low-level public contracts from failed discovery.
